boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus study environments, from quiet reading rooms to reservable rooms and student-support lounges.

cards.title: Helen Robson Walton Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Set up here when you need a designated quiet study area; bring your course materials and use the reading-room setting for focused solo work.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study reading room in Mullins Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026–27 University of Arkansas catalog identifies the Helen Robson Walton Reading Room as a quiet study area in Mullins Library.
cards.source_title: University Libraries | University of Arkansas Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Mullins Library; consult current library building hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Lindley and Kaneaster Hodges Jr. Reading Room
cards.title: Lindley and Kaneaster Hodges Jr. Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use this named Level 2 reading room for a quiet work session, and check Mullins Library hours before planning a longer visit.
cards.short_summary: A Level 2 Mullins reading room recommended for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies the Lindley and Kaneaster Hodges Jr. Reading Room on Level 2 as a place for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Mullins Library Adds Group Study Space | Arkansas News
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Mullins Library; verify current library hours before arrival.

cards.entity_name: Mullins Library Level 3 Quiet Study Areas
cards.title: Mullins Library Level 3 Quiet Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Choose the Level 3 quiet areas when silence matters; keep phone use outside designated quiet study spaces under the library policy.
cards.short_summary: Designated quiet study areas on Mullins Library’s third level.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists quiet study areas on Level 3 of Mullins Library and its policy designates quiet study spaces.
cards.source_title: Library Maps, Locations, and Directions | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use during Mullins Library open hours; quiet-space expectations apply.

cards.title: Mullins Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 2 west side
cards.notes: Reserve an individual room for one or two people when a whiteboard and contained workspace will help; arrive during open library hours.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Level 2 rooms with Wi-Fi and dry-erase boards.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullins individual study rooms 201A–201J are designed for one to two people and provide Wi-Fi and dry-erase boards.
cards.source_title: Libraries Policies | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current UARK affiliates with valid UARK email may reserve up to four hours per day; reservations are valid only while the library is open.

cards.entity_name: Mullins Library Small Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Mullins Library Small Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Levels 3 and 4
cards.notes: Book a small group room for a working session of up to four people; use its Wi-Fi and dry-erase board to map out the task together.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for groups of up to four with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullins small group study rooms accommodate up to four people and provide Wi-Fi and dry-erase boards.
cards.source_title: Libraries Policies | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Rooms are on Levels 3 and 4; current UARK affiliates may reserve up to four hours per day while the library is open.

cards.entity_name: Mullins Library Large Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Mullins Library Large Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Levels 3 and 4
cards.notes: Reserve a large group room when your project needs a shared monitor, HDMI connection, and whiteboard; bring a computer to connect.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms with display monitors and HDMI.
cards.evidence_claim: Mullins large group study rooms accommodate five or six people and include a display monitor, HDMI connection, dry-erase board, and Wi-Fi.
cards.source_title: Libraries Policies | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current UARK affiliates may reserve up to four hours per day; rooms are open and unlocked during library open hours.

cards.title: Graduate Student Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Room 333
cards.notes: Graduate students can use this Level 3 reading room for sustained individual work; bring an ID card for entry and confirm building hours first.
cards.short_summary: ID-card-access reading room for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists the Graduate Student Reading Room as Room 333 on the west side of Mullins Level 3 with ID-card access.
cards.source_title: Libraries Policies | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Graduate-student space with ID-card access; located on Level 3 and subject to library hours.

cards.title: Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union, 6th floor
cards.notes: Head to the sixth-floor Commuter Lounge for an on-campus work session, especially when you want a lounge setting rather than a library room.
cards.short_summary: A sixth-floor Arkansas Union lounge identified as a study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Commuter Student Success identifies the Commuter Lounge on the sixth floor of the Union as a place to study.
cards.source_title: About | Freshman Commuter Student Success | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Located on the sixth floor of the Arkansas Union; confirm current Union access hours before visiting.

cards.title: Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union, Room 404
cards.notes: Use the Multicultural Center’s Union location as a social study option; coordinate your visit with the center’s current access and programming schedule.
cards.short_summary: A named Arkansas Union study option in Room 404.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Commuter Student Success lists the Multicultural Center, located in Arkansas Union Room 404, among campus study places.
cards.source_title: About | Freshman Commuter Student Success | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Located in Arkansas Union Room 404; confirm current center and Union access details before going.

cards.title: Gearhart Honors Lounge
cards.subtitle: University of Arkansas campus
cards.notes: Plan a focused solo session in the Gearhart Honors Lounge, which the university identifies as a quiet campus study option.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study lounge named by the university’s commuter-student program.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Commuter Student Success lists the Gearhart Honors Lounge as a campus study location and describes it as very quiet with chairs and couches.
cards.source_title: About | Freshman Commuter Student Success | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Confirm current Honors College lounge access requirements and building hours before visiting.
